prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a parking lot collision. The patient had 21 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1061; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text:
Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of headache, dizziness, and cognitive fatigue consistent with concussion. The mechanism of injury and the force of the impact are considered well matched to the reported symptoms. Over the course of 21 visits, care included neurological assessment, vestibular and balance evaluation, graded symptom monitoring, and graduated return-to-activity guidance. Several examination findings, including mild balance deficits and reduced tolerance to visual tracking tasks, support the diagnosis, while other standard neurological tests, such as cranial nerve function, strength, and reflexes, returned normal. No prior injury to the head or neck region is known. Treatment followed an expected clinical course, with visit frequency and intensity tapering as symptoms improved and function returned. Billing records reflect single, appropriate charges for each service rendered without duplication. Ongoing follow-up is recommended only if symptoms recur.
